title: intake_stamp
description: One stamp attempt of one issue version: the intake step read the issue body and the loop applied (or dropped) what the stamp answered. Count one per (issue, version, attempt).

version.description: The hash of the issue body the stamp read.

mode.description: run: the stamp was applied. dry: a dry run. The loop writes only run; dry exists so the type can name a dry run.

outcome.description: ok: the stamp was applied. failed: the stamp step did not produce an answer. dropped: the answer broke the contract.

area.description: The area the stamp named, or null when there is none.

needs_owner.description: Whether the stamp says the issue needs the owner, or null when there is no answer.

reason.description: The one-line needs_owner reason, or null. On a run that failed without an answer (outcome failed), why it ended: timeout, lost, spawn-failed or the read or answer problem.

touches.description: The top-level paths the stamp says the issue touches.

dropped.description: The answer fields the contract dropped.

labels_kept.description: The labels the loop left alone because the owner had changed them.

input_tokens.description: The input tokens of an ended run's agent transcript and every agent nested under it, once per request (loop_entry: an agent step; intake_stamp: the stamp run); null while running, for other kinds and when the transcript could not be read.

output_tokens.description: The output tokens of an ended run, counted as input_tokens; null otherwise.

cache_read_tokens.description: The cache-read input tokens of an ended run, counted as input_tokens; null otherwise.

cache_creation_tokens.description: The cache-creation input tokens of an ended run, counted as input_tokens; null otherwise.

cost_usd.description: The what-if cost of an ended run at Anthropic's public API prices (each request priced at its own model), not a bill; null while running, on other kinds, when a model is unpriced and on older loops.

examples.reason: The brief asks for a choice only the owner can make.
